content.thinking: The `time` builtin with the pipeline had an issue; /tmp may not be writable ("no writable directory outside the submission tree, including /tmp, is promised"). Indeed /tmp might not be writable in this sandbox. Let me write outputs to /workspace/tmp.

arguments.command: cd /workspace/tmp && for s in 1 2 3; do echo "--- seed $s"; start=$(date +%s.%N); /workspace/submission/run.sh < big$s.json > out$s.json; end=$(date +%s.%N); echo "elapsed: $(echo "$end - $start" | bc)"; head -c 250 out$s.json; echo; done
